sentences.zh: 天福六年秋七月己未朔，帝御崇元殿視朝。

translations.literal: On the first day of the month (jiwei) in the seventh month of autumn in the sixth year of Tianfu, the Emperor attended court at Chongyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon (jiwei) of the seventh month in autumn of Tianfu 6, the Emperor held court at Chongyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，升陳州為防禦使額。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chen Prefecture was elevated to defense commissioner status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chen Prefecture was raised to defense commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前鄧州節度使焦方為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the former military governor of Dengzhou, Jiao Fang, was appointed military governor of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Jiao Fang, former military governor of Dengzhou, was made military governor of Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，涇州奏，西涼府留後李文謙，今年二月四日閉宅門自焚，遣元入西涼府譯語官與來人賫三部族蕃書進之。

translations.literal: On renxu, Jingzhou reported that Li Wenqian, acting commissioner of Xiliang Prefecture, on the fourth day of the second month of this year closed his residence gate and burned himself to death; he had sent his son into Xiliang Prefecture with an interpreter and the visitors bearing tribal documents from three clans to present them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Jingzhou reported that Li Wenqian, acting commissioner of Xiliang, had shut his gates and burned himself to death on the fourth day of the second month; his son had entered Xiliang with an interpreter and the envoys, bearing tribal documents from three clans for presentation at court.

sentences.zh: 以三司使劉審交為陳州防禦使。

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Three Departments Liu Shenjiao was appointed defense commissioner of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shenjiao, commissioner of the Three Departments, was appointed defense commissioner of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以前鄆州節度使趙在禮為許州節度使，以前鄴都留守、廣晉尹高行周為河南尹、西都留守。

translations.literal: On guihai, the former military governor of Yanzhou, Zhao Zaili, was appointed military governor of Xuzhou; the former garrison commander of Yedu and Guangjin prefect, Gao Xingzhou, was appointed prefect of Henan and garrison commander of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhao Zaili, former military governor of Yanzhou, became military governor of Xuzhou; Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu garrison commander and Guangjin prefect, became prefect of Henan and garrison commander of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔改拱辰、威和、內直等軍並為興順。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the armies Gongchen, Weihe, Neizhi, and others all be renamed Xingshun.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed the Gongchen, Weihe, Neizhi, and related armies Xingshun.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以宣徽使、權西京留守張從恩判三司。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Palace Secretariat commissioner and acting garrison commander of the Western Capital Zhang Cong'en was assigned to administer the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Zhang Cong'en, palace secretariat commissioner and acting Western Capital garrison commander, was put in charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以鄴都留守兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、廣晉尹劉知遠為太原尹，充北京留守、河東節度使，仍割遼、沁二州卻隸河東。

translations.literal: On jisi, Yedu garrison commander and commander-in-chief of the palace guard horse and foot armies and Guangjin prefect Liu Zhiyuan was appointed prefect of Taiyuan, serving as garrison commander of the Northern Capital and military governor of Hedong; the two prefectures of Liao and Qin were detached and reassigned to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Liu Zhiyuan, Yedu garrison commander, commander-in-chief of the palace guard horse and foot armies, and Guangjin prefect, was made prefect of Taiyuan, Northern Capital garrison commander, and Hedong military governor; Liao and Qin prefectures were restored to Hedong jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 以北京留守李德充為廣晉尹，充鄴都留守；

translations.literal: Northern Capital garrison commander Li Dechong was appointed Guangjin prefect and Yedu garrison commander;
translations.idiomatic: Li Dechong, Northern Capital garrison commander, was appointed Guangjin prefect and Yedu garrison commander;

sentences.zh: 以昭義節度使馬全節為邢州節度使，加同平章事。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi military governor Ma Quanjie was appointed military governor of Xingzhou and given the additional title of co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Quanjie, military governor of Zhaoyi, was made military governor of Xingzhou and promoted to co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「今後諸道行軍副使，不得奏薦骨肉為殿直供奉官。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict stated: "Henceforth, deputy commanders on campaign from all circuits may not memorialize recommending their kin for appointment as palace attendants or tribute commissioners."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict declared: "From now on, deputy campaign commanders in all circuits may not petition to have relatives appointed as palace attendants or tribute commissioners."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，以前陜州節度使李從敏為昭義軍節度使，以陜州節度使景延廣為河陽三城節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候，以河陽節度使石赟為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: " On jimao, the former military governor of Shaanzhou, Li Congmin, was appointed military governor of Zhaoyi; military governor of Shaanzhou Jing Yanguang was appointed military governor of the Three Cities of Heyang and chief adjutant of the palace guard horse and foot armies; military governor of Heyang Shi Yun was appointed military governor of Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao, Li Congmin, former military governor of Shaanzhou, became military governor of Zhaoyi; Jing Yanguang, military governor of Shaanzhou, became military governor of the Three Cities of Heyang and chief adjutant of the palace guard horse and foot armies; Shi Yun, military governor of Heyang, became military governor of Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，突厥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Turks sent envoys to offer tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Turks sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 以遙領壽州忠正軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李懷忠為同州節度使，以宣徽北院使李守貞遙領忠正軍節度使、侍衛馬軍指揮使。

translations.literal: Li Huaizhong, titular military governor of the Zhongzheng Army at Shouzhou and commander of the palace guard cavalry, was appointed military governor of Tongzhou; Northern Palace Secretariat commissioner Li Shouzhen was given titular appointment as military governor of the Zhongzheng Army and commander of the palace guard cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaizhong, titular Zhongzheng Army military governor at Shouzhou and commander of the palace cavalry, was made military governor of Tongzhou; Li Shouzhen, Northern Palace Secretariat commissioner, was given titular command of the Zhongzheng Army and the palace cavalry.

sentences.zh: 甲申，降御劄，取八月五日暫幸鄴都，沿路供頓，並委所司以官物排比，州縣不得科率人戶。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an imperial rescript was issued: on the fifth day of the eighth month the Emperor would temporarily visit Yedu; supplies along the route were all to be arranged by the responsible offices from government stores, and prefectures and counties were forbidden to levy the populace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, an imperial rescript announced a temporary visit to Yedu on the fifth of the eighth month; provisioning along the route was to come from official stores through the responsible agencies, and local governments were forbidden to impose levies on households.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以右諫議大夫趙遠為中書舍人，吏部郎中鄭受益為右諫議大夫，刑部郎中殷鵬為水部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Right Remonstrance Counselor Zhao Yuan was appointed Secretariat drafter; Bureau Director of the Ministry of Personnel Zheng Shouyi was appointed Right Remonstrance Counselor; Bureau Director of the Ministry of Justice Yin Peng was appointed Bureau Director of the Ministry of Works and given charge of drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhao Yuan, Right Remonstrance Counselor, became a Secretariat drafter; Zheng Shouyi, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Personnel, became Right Remonstrance Counselor; Yin Peng, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice, became Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works with charge of drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子朔，以皇子開封尹、鄭王重貴為東京留守，以天平軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍副都指揮使杜重威為侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使，以宣徽南院使張從恩為東京內外兵馬都監。

translations.literal: On the first day of the month (wuzi) in the eighth month, the Prince of Zheng, Chonggui, imperial prince and Kaifeng prefect, was appointed garrison commander of the Eastern Capital; military governor of the Tianping Army and deputy commander-in-chief of the palace guard horse and foot armies Du Chongwei was appointed commander-in-chief of the palace guard horse and foot armies; Southern Palace Secretariat commissioner Zhang Cong'en was appointed overall supervisor of military affairs inside and outside the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon (wuzi) of the eighth month, Prince Chonggui of Zheng, imperial prince and Kaifeng prefect, was made garrison commander of the Eastern Capital; Du Chongwei, military governor of the Tianping Army and deputy commander of the palace guard horse and foot armies, became their commander-in-chief; Zhang Cong'en, Southern Palace Secretariat commissioner, was made overall military supervisor for the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改奉德馬軍為護聖。

translations.literal: The Fengde Cavalry Army was renamed Husheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengde Cavalry Army was renamed Husheng.

sentences.zh: 放文武百官朝參，取便先赴鄴都。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were released from court attendance and permitted to proceed to Yedu at their convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were excused from court and allowed to travel to Yedu at their convenience.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，車駕發東京。

translations.literal: On renchen, the imperial carriage departed the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Emperor departed the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，至鄴，左右金吾六軍儀仗排列如儀，迎引入內。

translations.literal: On jihai, the Emperor arrived at Ye; the Left and Right Imperial Guards and the Six Armies formed their ceremonial arrays according to protocol and welcomed him inside.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, upon reaching Ye, the Left and Right Imperial Guards and the Six Armies formed their ceremonial arrays and escorted him within.

sentences.zh: 改舊澶州為德清軍。

translations.literal: The former Chanzou was renamed the Deqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Former Chanzou was redesignated the Deqing Army.

sentences.zh: 以內客省使劉遂清為宣徽北院使，判三司。

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau Liu Suiqing was appointed Northern Palace Secretariat commissioner and assigned to administer the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Suiqing, commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, became Northern Palace Secretariat commissioner with charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制：「應天福六年八月十五日昧爽已前，諸色罪犯，常赦所不原者，咸赦除之；

translations.literal: On renyin, an ordinance stated: "For all categories of crime committed before dawn on the fifteenth day of the eighth month in the sixth year of Tianfu, even those not normally pardoned by regular amnesties shall be fully pardoned and absolved;
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an ordinance declared: "All crimes committed before dawn on the fifteenth of the eighth month, Tianfu 6—even those ordinary amnesties do not cover—are hereby fully pardoned;

sentences.zh: 其持仗行劫及殺人賊，並免罪移鄉，配逐處軍都收管；

translations.literal: those guilty of armed robbery on the road and murder shall all be absolved of guilt, relocated to other districts, and assigned to local army commands for custody;
translations.idiomatic: armed robbers and murderers shall be absolved, relocated, and placed under local army custody;

sentences.zh: 犯枉法贓者，雖免罪不得再任用；

translations.literal: those guilty of illegal exaction of goods, though absolved of guilt, may not be employed again;
translations.idiomatic: those guilty of illegal exactions, though pardoned, may never again hold office;

sentences.zh: 諸徒流人並放還；

translations.literal: all those sentenced to penal servitude or exile shall be released and returned;
translations.idiomatic: all those in penal servitude or exile shall be released;

sentences.zh: 貶降官未量移與量移者，約資敘用。

translations.literal: demoted officials whether not yet reassigned by quota or already reassigned shall be considered for restoration according to their qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: demoted officials, whether awaiting reassignment or already reassigned, shall be considered for restoration according to qualification;

sentences.zh: 天福五年終已前殘稅並放。

translations.literal: All outstanding taxes before the end of the fifth year of Tianfu shall be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: all outstanding taxes due before the close of Tianfu 5 are remitted.

sentences.zh: 應河東起義之初及收復鄴都、汜水立功將校，並與加恩；

translations.literal: officers and soldiers who rendered merit at the beginning of the Hedong uprising and in recovering Yedu and Sishui shall all receive additional favor;
translations.idiomatic: officers and soldiers who distinguished themselves at the start of the Hedong uprising and in recovering Yedu and Sishui shall receive additional rewards;

sentences.zh: 亡歿者與追贈。

translations.literal: those who died shall receive posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: the dead shall receive posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 自東京至鄴都緣路，昨因行幸，有損踐田苗處，據頃畝與放今年租稅。

translations.literal: Along the route from the Eastern Capital to Yedu, wherever crops were trampled during the recent imperial progress, this year's land tax shall be remitted according to the acreage affected.
translations.idiomatic: along the route from the Eastern Capital to Yedu, wherever the imperial progress trampled crops, this year's land tax is remitted in proportion to the damage.

sentences.zh: 鄴都管內，有潛龍時在職者，並與加恩。

translations.literal: Within the jurisdiction of Yedu, all who held office during the period before the Emperor's rise shall receive additional favor.
translations.idiomatic: within Yedu jurisdiction, all who served during the Emperor's years before the throne shall receive additional rewards.

sentences.zh: 耆年八十已上者，版授上佐官。

translations.literal: The elderly aged eighty and above shall be granted honorary senior adjutant rank by patent.
translations.idiomatic: those aged eighty and above shall receive honorary senior adjutant rank.

sentences.zh: 天下農器，並許百姓自鑄造。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, the people are permitted to cast their own farm implements.
translations.idiomatic: throughout the realm, commoners may cast their own farm tools.

sentences.zh: 亡命山澤者，招喚歸業；

translations.literal: Those who have fled to the mountains and marshes shall be summoned to return to their occupations;
translations.idiomatic: fugitives in mountains and marshes shall be summoned home;

sentences.zh: 百日不出者，復罪如初。

translations.literal: those who do not come forth within one hundred days shall be punished as before.
translations.idiomatic: those who fail to come forth within one hundred days shall be punished as originally sentenced.

sentences.zh: 唐梁國公狄仁傑宜追贈官秩。

translations.literal: Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, should receive posthumous conferral of office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, should receive posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 應天福三年已前，敗闕場院官無家業者，並與除放，其人免罪，永不任使。

translations.literal: For granary and depot officials who failed in duty before the third year of Tianfu and have no family property, all debts shall be written off; the persons themselves shall be absolved of guilt and never again employed.
translations.idiomatic: granary and depot officials who failed in duty before Tianfu 3 and lack family property shall have all debts written off; they are absolved but may never hold office again.

sentences.zh: 私下債負征利及一倍者並放，主持者不在此限。

translations.literal: Private debts with interest charged up to double the principal shall all be remitted; brokers are not included in this provision.
translations.idiomatic: private debts with interest up to double the principal are remitted; brokers are excepted.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，以客省使、將作監丁知浚為內客省使，引進使、鴻臚卿王景崇為客省使，殿中監、判四方館事劉政恩為引進使。

translations.literal: " On dingwei, Guests Bureau commissioner and Director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories Ding Zhijun was appointed commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau; Introduction Bureau commissioner and Minister of Ceremonial Wang Jingchong was appointed Guests Bureau commissioner; Director of the Palace Domestic Service and administrator of the Four Directions Hostel Liu Zheng'en was appointed Introduction Bureau commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingwei, Ding Zhijun, Guests Bureau commissioner and Director of Imperial Manufactories, became Inner Guests Bureau commissioner; Wang Jingchong, Introduction Bureau commissioner and Minister of Ceremonial, became Guests Bureau commissioner; Liu Zheng'en, Director of Palace Domestic Service and administrator of the Four Directions Hostel, became Introduction Bureau commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改鄴都皇城南門應天門為乾明門，大明館為都亭驛。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Yedu imperial city south gate Yingtian Gate was renamed Qianming Gate, and the Daming Hostel was renamed Duting Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Yedu's imperial south gate Yingtian was renamed Qianming, and the Daming Hostel became Duting Post Station.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣光祿卿張澄、國子博士謝攀使高麗行冊禮。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Minister of the Imperial Household Zhang Cheng and Erudite of the National University Xie Pan were dispatched to Goryeo to perform investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhang Cheng, Minister of the Imperial Household, and Xie Pan, Erudite of the National University, were sent to Goryeo to perform investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以兵部侍郎閻至為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiwei, Vice Minister of War Yan Zhi was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiwei, Yan Zhi, Vice Minister of War, became Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滑州河決，一溉東流，鄉村戶民攜老幼登丘冢，為水所隔，餓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Yellow River breached its banks at Huazhou; the flood spread eastward; rural households carried the old and young up to mounds and tombs, cut off by the water, and very many died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Yellow River broke its banks at Huazhou and spread east; villagers fled with the old and young to mounds and tombs, cut off by floodwaters, and many starved to death.

sentences.zh: 壬申，忠武建武等軍節度使、守太傅、兼中書令、行蘇州睦州刺史錢元尞進封彭城郡王，遙領廣州清海軍節度使、判婺州軍州事錢元懿為檢校太師。

translations.literal: On renshen, Qian Yuanliao, military governor of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies and others, Grand Mentor, and concurrently Secretariat Director, acting prefect of Suzhou and Muzhou, was advanced to Prince of Pengcheng Commandery; Qian Yuanyi, titular military governor of the Qinghai Army at Guangzhou and administrator of military and civil affairs at Wuzhou, was appointed honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Qian Yuanliao, military governor of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies, Grand Mentor, and concurrently Secretariat Director, acting prefect of Suzhou and Muzhou, was advanced to Prince of Pengcheng; Qian Yuanyi, titular Qinghai Army military governor at Guangzhou and administrator of Wuzhou, was made honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣前邢州節度使楊彥詢使於契丹，錫賫甚厚。

translations.literal: On yihai, former military governor of Xingzhou Yang Yanxun was dispatched as envoy to the Khitan; gifts and rewards were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yang Yanxun, former military governor of Xingzhou, was sent as envoy to the Khitan with lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，吐渾遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Tuyuhun sent envoys to offer tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Tuyuhun sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午夜，有彗星出於西方，長二丈餘，在房一度，尾跡穿天市垣東行，逾月而滅。

translations.literal: At midnight on renwu, a comet appeared in the west, more than two zhang in length, within one degree of the Room asterism; its tail crossed the eastern wall of the Celestial Market and proceeded eastward, vanishing after more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on renwu, a comet appeared in the west, over two zhang long, within one degree of the Room asterism; its tail crossed the Celestial Market wall and swept eastward, disappearing after more than a month.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，兗州上言，水自西來，漂沒秋稼。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Yanzhou reported that water came from the west and washed away the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yanzhou reported floodwaters from the west had destroyed the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，遣鴻臚少卿魏比等四人，分往滑、濮、鄆、澶視水害苗稼。

translations.literal: On the first day of the month (dinghai) in the tenth month of winter, Vice Minister of Ceremonial Wei Bi and three others were dispatched separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Chan to inspect flood damage to crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon (dinghai) of the tenth winter month, Wei Bi, Vice Minister of Ceremonial, and three others were sent separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Chan to inspect flood damage to crops.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔以胡梁度月城為大通軍，浮橋為大通橋。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict ordered that the Huliang ferry moon-city be named the Datong Army and the pontoon bridge be named the Datong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, an edict renamed the Huliang ferry moon-city the Datong Army and its pontoon bridge the Datong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔唐梁國公狄仁傑可贈太師。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict ordered that Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, be posthumously conferred as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict posthumously conferred Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，以東京留守、開封尹、鄭王重貴為廣晉尹，進封齊王；

translations.literal: On the first day of the month (bingxu) in the twelfth month, Eastern Capital garrison commander, Kaifeng prefect, and Prince of Zheng Chonggui was appointed Guangjin prefect and advanced to Prince of Qi;
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon (bingxu) of the twelfth month, Chonggui, Prince of Zheng, Eastern Capital garrison commander and Kaifeng prefect, was made Guangjin prefect and advanced to Prince of Qi;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都留守、廣晉尹李德充為開封尹，充東京留守。

translations.literal: Yedu garrison commander and Guangjin prefect Li Dechong was appointed Kaifeng prefect and Eastern Capital garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dechong, Yedu garrison commander and Guangjin prefect, became Kaifeng prefect and Eastern Capital garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 南面軍前奏，十一月二十七日，武德使焦繼勛、先鋒都指揮使郭金海等於唐州南遇安從進賊軍一萬餘人，大破之，

translations.literal: The southern army front reported that on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month, Military Virtue commissioner Jiao Jixun, vanguard commander Guo Jinhai, and others encountered more than ten thousand troops of the rebel An Congjin south of Tangzhou and routed them utterly,
translations.idiomatic: The southern front reported that on the twenty-seventh of the eleventh month, Jiao Jixun, Military Virtue commissioner, Guo Jinhai, vanguard commander, and others met more than ten thousand of An Congjin's rebel troops south of Tangzhou and routed them,

translations.literal: [Editorial note:
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·陳思讓傳》：思讓為先鋒右廂都監，從武德焦繼勛領兵進討，遇從進之師於唐州花山下，急擊，大破之。）〉

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Chen Sirang: Sirang was vanguard right wing supervisor; he followed Military Virtue commissioner Jiao Jixun in leading troops on the punitive campaign, encountered Congjin's army below Flower Mountain at Tangzhou, attacked swiftly, and routed them utterly.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Chen Sirang in the Song History: Sirang served as supervisor of the vanguard right wing; marching with Jiao Jixun of Military Virtue, he met Congjin's army below Flower Mountain at Tangzhou, attacked at once, and won a crushing victory.)〉

sentences.zh: 生擒衙內都指揮使安宏義，獲山南東道之印，其安從進單騎奔逸。

translations.literal: They captured alive An Hongyi, commander of the palace guard; they seized the seal of the Shannan East Circuit; An Congjin himself fled on a single horse.
translations.idiomatic: They took An Hongyi, commander of the palace guard, alive, seized the seal of the Shannan East Circuit, and An Congjin himself fled alone on horseback.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔襄州行營都部署高行周權知襄州軍州事。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict appointed Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters, acting administrator of military and civil affairs at Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict made Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters, acting administrator of Xiangzhou military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 是日，鎮州節度使安重榮稱兵向闕，以侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使杜重威為北面行營招討使，率兵擊之，以邢州節度使馬全節為副，以前貝州節度使王周為馬步軍都虞候。

translations.literal: On that day, An Chongrong, military governor of Zhenzhou, raised troops and marched on the capital; Du Chongwei, commander-in-chief of the palace guard horse and foot armies, was appointed northern campaign pacification commissioner to lead troops against him; Ma Quanjie, military governor of Xingzhou, was made his deputy; former military governor of Beizhou Wang Zhou was made chief adjutant of the horse and foot armies.
translations.idiomatic: That day, An Chongrong, military governor of Zhenzhou, rebelled and marched on the capital; Du Chongwei, commander of the palace guard horse and foot armies, was appointed northern pacification commissioner to lead the attack; Ma Quanjie, military governor of Xingzhou, served as his deputy; Wang Zhou, former military governor of Beizhou, became chief adjutant of the horse and foot armies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，武德使焦繼勛奏，安從進遣弟從貴領兵千人，取接均州刺史蔡行遇，尋領所部兵掩殺賊軍七百餘人，生擒安從貴，截其雙腕，卻放入城。

translations.literal: On guisi, Military Virtue commissioner Jiao Jixun reported that An Congjin had sent his younger brother Conggui leading a thousand troops to link up with Junzhou prefect Cai Xingyu; shortly afterward he led his own troops in a surprise attack and killed more than seven hundred rebel soldiers, captured Conggui alive, severed both his wrists, and then sent him back into the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Jiao Jixun reported that An Congjin had sent his brother Conggui with a thousand men to join Junzhou prefect Cai Xingyu; Conggui then led a surprise attack that killed over seven hundred rebels, took him alive, severed both wrists, and sent him back into the city.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以皇子重睿為銀青光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the imperial prince Chongrui was appointed Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and honorary Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, the imperial prince Chongrui was appointed Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and honorary Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己亥，北面軍前奏，十三日未時，於宗城縣西南大破鎮州賊軍，殺一萬五千人，餘黨走保宗城縣。

translations.literal: On jihai, the northern army front reported that on the thirteenth day at the wei hour, southwest of Zongcheng County they routed the Zhenzhou rebel army utterly, killing fifteen thousand men; the remaining bandits fled to hold Zongcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the northern front reported that on the thirteenth at the wei hour, southwest of Zongcheng County, they crushed the Zhenzhou rebels, killing fifteen thousand; the survivors fled into Zongcheng County.

sentences.zh: 是夜三更，破縣城，前深州刺史史虔武自縛歸降。

translations.literal: At the third watch that night they stormed the county seat; Shi Qianwu, former prefect of Shenzhou, bound himself and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That night at the third watch they took the county seat; Shi Qianwu, former prefect of Shenzhou, bound himself and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 獲馬三千匹，絹三萬餘匹，餘物稱是。

translations.literal: They captured three thousand horses, more than thirty thousand bolts of silk, and other goods in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: They seized three thousand horses, over thirty thousand bolts of silk, and comparable quantities of other goods.

sentences.zh: 安重榮脫身遁走。

translations.literal: An Chongrong escaped and fled.
translations.idiomatic: An Chongrong escaped and fled.

sentences.zh: 是日，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: On that day the civil and military officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That day the officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，削奪安從進、安重榮在身官爵。

translations.literal: On guimao, the offices and titles held by An Congjin and An Chongrong were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, An Congjin and An Chongrong were stripped of their offices and titles.

sentences.zh: 右金吾上將軍萇從簡卒，廢朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: Chang Congjian, General-in-Chief of the Right Imperial Guard, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously conferred as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Congjian, General-in-Chief of the Right Imperial Guard, died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天下兵馬都元帥、守尚書令、吳越國王錢元瓘薨，廢朝三日，謚曰文穆。

translations.literal: On yisi, Qian Yuanguan, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven, Guardian Minister of the Imperial Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, died; court was suspended for three days; his posthumous title was Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Qian Yuanguan, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses, Guardian Minister of the Imperial Secretariat, and King of Wuyue, died; court was suspended for three days; his posthumous title was Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝習射於後苑，諸軍都指揮使已上悉預焉，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On that day the Emperor practiced archery in the rear garden; all army commanders-in-chief and above attended; gifts were bestowed in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor practiced archery in the rear garden; all army commanders-in-chief and above attended, and gifts were bestowed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丁未，南面行營都部署高行周奏，今月十三日，部領大軍至襄州城下，相次降賊軍二千人。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Gao Xingzhou, overall commander of the southern field headquarters, reported that on the thirteenth day of this month he led the main army to the walls of Xiangzhou, and rebel troops surrendered in succession, two thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Gao Xingzhou, southern field commander, reported that on the thirteenth he led the main army to Xiangzhou, where two thousand rebel troops surrendered in succession.

sentences.zh: 其降兵馬軍詔以「彰聖」為號，步軍以「歸順」為號。

translations.literal: The surrendered cavalry were by edict given the designation Zhangsheng; the infantry were given the designation Guishun.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered cavalry were designated Zhangsheng by edict; the infantry were designated Guishun.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以權知吳越國事錢宏佐為起復鎮軍大將軍、檢校太師、兼中書令、杭州越州大都督、鎮海鎮東等軍節度使，封吳越國王。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Qian Hongzuo, acting administrator of Wuyue state affairs, was appointed on resumption from mourning as General of the Suppressing Army, honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrently Secretariat Director, Grand Protector-General of Hangzhou and Yuezhou, and military governor of the Zhenhai and Zhendong armies and others, and was enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Qian Hongzuo, acting administrator of Wuyue affairs, was recalled from mourning as General of the Suppressing Army, honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrently Secretariat Director, Grand Protector-General of Hangzhou and Yuezhou, military governor of the Zhenhai and Zhendong armies, and enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.

sentences.zh: 壬子，杜重威部領大軍至鎮州城下。

translations.literal: On renzi, Du Chongwei led the main army to the walls of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Du Chongwei led the main army to the walls of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 天福七年春正月丙辰朔，不受朝賀，用兵故也。

translations.literal: On the first day of the month (bingchen) in the first month of spring in the seventh year of Tianfu, the Emperor did not receive congratulatory court audiences, because troops were in the field.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon (bingchen) of the first month in spring of Tianfu 7, the Emperor declined congratulatory audiences because of active military operations.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前將作監李鍇為少府監。

translations.literal: On wuwu, former Director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories Li Kai was appointed Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Li Kai, former Director of Imperial Manufactories, became Director of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 北面招討使杜重威奏，今月二日收復鎮州，斬安重榮，傳首闕下。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, northern pacification commissioner, reported that on the second day of this month Zhenzhou was recovered, An Chongrong was beheaded, and his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei, northern pacification commissioner, reported that on the second of the month Zhenzhou was recovered, An Chongrong was beheaded, and his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝御乾明樓，宣露布訖，大理卿受馘，付市徇之，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: The Emperor attended Qianming Tower, proclaimed the victory bulletin, and when it was finished the Minister of Justice received the severed head and had it displayed in the market as a warning; the civil and military officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor went to Qianming Tower and proclaimed the victory bulletin; the Minister of Justice then received the severed head and had it displayed in the market; the officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 曲赦廣晉府禁囚。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the Guangjin prefecture jail.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners held in the Guangjin prefecture jail.

translations.literal: [Editorial note:
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《遼史》云：戊辰，晉函安重榮首來獻，上數欲親討重榮，至是乃止。）〉

translations.literal: (Liao History states: On wuchen, Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a box as tribute; the Khitan ruler had several times wished to campaign against Chongrong in person, and only then ceased.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The Liao History records: On wuchen, Later Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a box; the Khitan ruler had repeatedly wished to campaign against Chongrong in person and only then abandoned the plan.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，追贈皇弟三人：故沂州馬步軍都指揮使、贈太傅德再贈太尉，追封福王；

translations.literal: On xinyou, three imperial younger brothers were posthumously honored: the late commander of horse and foot armies at Yizhou, posthumously Grand Mentor De, was further posthumously made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Fu;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, three imperial younger brothers received posthumous honors: De, late commander of horse and foot armies at Yizhou and posthumously Grand Mentor, was further made Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fu;

sentences.zh: 故檢校太子賓客、贈太傅殷再贈太尉，追封通王；

translations.literal: the late honorary Crown Prince's Mentor and posthumously Grand Mentor Yin was further posthumously made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Tong;
translations.idiomatic: Yin, late honorary Crown Prince's Mentor and posthumously Grand Mentor, was further made Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tong;

sentences.zh: 故彰聖右第三軍都指揮使長州刺史、贈大傅威再贈太尉，追封廣王。

translations.literal: the late commander of the Zhangsheng Right Third Army and prefect of Changzhou, posthumously Grand Tutor Wei, was further posthumously made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, late commander of the Zhangsheng Right Third Army and prefect of Changzhou and posthumously Grand Tutor, was further made Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，追贈皇子五人：故右衛將軍、贈太保重英再贈太傅，追封虢王；

translations.literal: On renxu, five imperial sons were posthumously honored: the late General of the Right Imperial Guard and posthumously Grand Mentor Chongying was further posthumously made Grand Tutor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Guo;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, five imperial sons received posthumous honors: Chongying, late General of the Right Imperial Guard and posthumously Grand Mentor, was further made Grand Tutor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guo;

sentences.zh: 故權東京留守、河南尹、贈太傅重乂再贈太尉，追封壽王；

translations.literal: the late acting Eastern Capital garrison commander and Henan prefect and posthumously Grand Mentor Chongyi was further posthumously made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Shou;
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, late acting Eastern Capital garrison commander and Henan prefect and posthumously Grand Mentor, was further made Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;

sentences.zh: 故皇城副使、贈太保重裔再贈太傅，追封郯王；

translations.literal: the late deputy commissioner of the Imperial City and posthumously Grand Mentor Chongyi was further posthumously made Grand Tutor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Tan;
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, late deputy commissioner of the Imperial City and posthumously Grand Mentor, was further made Grand Tutor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tan;

sentences.zh: 故河陽節度使、贈太尉重信再贈太師，追封沂王；

translations.literal: the late military governor of Heyang and posthumously Grand Marshal Chongxin was further posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Yi;
translations.idiomatic: Chongxin, late military governor of Heyang and posthumously Grand Marshal, was further made Grand Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yi;

sentences.zh: 故左金吾衛將軍、贈太保重進再贈太傅，追封夔王。

translations.literal: the late General of the Left Imperial Guard and posthumously Grand Mentor Chongjin was further posthumously made Grand Tutor and enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Chongjin, late General of the Left Imperial Guard and posthumously Grand Mentor, was further made Grand Tutor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Kui.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，改鎮州為恒州，成德軍為順國軍。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhenzhou was renamed Hengzhou, and the Chengde Army was renamed the Shunguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhenzhou was renamed Hengzhou and the Chengde Army was renamed the Shunguo Army.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史趙瑩為侍中；

translations.literal: On bingyin, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and supervisor of the compilation of the national history Zhao Ying was appointed Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhao Ying, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and supervisor of the national history, became Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使楊光遠加食邑，改賜功臣名號；

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Qingzhou, received an increase in fief income and a change in the bestowed honorary merit title;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Qingzhou, received an increase in fief income and a new honorary merit title;

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使桑維翰加檢校太保；

translations.literal: Sang Weihan, military governor of Yanzhou, was given the additional title of honorary Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Sang Weihan, military governor of Yanzhou, was made honorary Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 河東節度使劉知遠加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of Hedong, was given the additional concurrent title of Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of Hedong, was made concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 以鄆州節度使、北面行營招討使、侍衛親軍都指揮使杜重威為恒州順國軍節度使，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, military governor of Yanzhou, northern campaign pacification commissioner, and commander-in-chief of the palace guard armies, was appointed military governor of the Shunguo Army at Hengzhou and given the additional concurrent title of Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei, military governor of Yanzhou, northern pacification commissioner, and commander of the palace guard armies, became military governor of the Shunguo Army at Hengzhou and concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 皇子廣晉尹兼功德使、齊王重貴加兼侍中；

translations.literal: the imperial prince, Guangjin prefect and commissioner of merit and virtue, Prince of Qi Chonggui, was given the additional concurrent title of Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Chonggui, imperial prince, Guangjin prefect, commissioner of merit and virtue, and Prince of Qi, was made concurrent Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 秦州節度使侯益加特進，增食邑。

translations.literal: Hou Yi, military governor of Qinzhou, was given the special advancement rank and an increase in fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Yi, military governor of Qinzhou, received the special advancement rank and an increase in fief income.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以判四方館事孟承誨為太府卿充職。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Meng Chenghui, administrator of the Four Directions Hostel, was appointed Minister of the Imperial Granaries to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Meng Chenghui, administrator of the Four Directions Hostel, was appointed Minister of the Imperial Granaries.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以滄州節度使安叔千為邢州節度使，以北面行營副招討使、邢州節度使馬全節為定州節度使，以定州節度使王庭胤為滄州節度使，以前邢州節度使楊彥詢為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, An Shuqian, military governor of Cangzhou, was appointed military governor of Xingzhou; Ma Quanjie, deputy northern campaign pacification commissioner and military governor of Xingzhou, was appointed military governor of Dingzhou; Wang Tingyin, military governor of Dingzhou, was appointed military governor of Cangzhou; Yang Yanxun, former military governor of Xingzhou, was appointed military governor of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, An Shuqian of Cangzhou became military governor of Xingzhou; Ma Quanjie, deputy northern pacification commissioner and military governor of Xingzhou, became military governor of Dingzhou; Wang Tingyin of Dingzhou became military governor of Cangzhou; Yang Yanxun, former military governor of Xingzhou, became military governor of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 恒州立功將校王溫以降等第除郡。

translations.literal: Wang Wen, an officer who rendered merit at Hengzhou, was appointed to a commandery by reduced grade ranking.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wen, an officer who distinguished himself at Hengzhou, received a commandery appointment at a reduced grade.

sentences.zh: 庚午，契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Khitan sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Khitan sent envoys on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 是日上元節，六街諸寺燃燈，禦乾明門觀之，夜半還宮。

translations.literal: That day was the Lantern Festival; lamps were lit in the temples along the six avenues; the Emperor went to Qianming Gate to view them and returned to the palace at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: That day was the Lantern Festival; temples along the six avenues lit lamps; the Emperor viewed them from Qianming Gate and returned to the palace at midnight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，延州節度使丁審琦加爵邑，鄧州節度使安審徽加檢校太傅，陜州節度使石赟加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On renshen, Ding Shenqi, military governor of Yanzhou, received an increase in noble rank and fief; An Shenhui, military governor of Dengzhou, was given the additional title of honorary Grand Tutor; Shi Yun, military governor of Shaanzhou, was given the additional title of honorary Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Ding Shenqi of Yanzhou received an increase in noble rank and fief; An Shenhui of Dengzhou and Shi Yun of Shaanzhou were made honorary Grand Tutors.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Khitan sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Khitan sent envoys on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 河陽節度使兼侍衛馬步軍都虞候景延廣加檢校太尉，改鄆州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Jing Yanguang, military governor of Heyang and chief adjutant of the palace guard horse and foot armies, was given the additional title of honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to military governor of Yanzhou, and continued to command the armies as before.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yanguang, military governor of Heyang and chief adjutant of the palace guard horse and foot armies, was made honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to Yanzhou, and continued to command the armies as before.

sentences.zh: 以前貝州節度使、北面行營馬步軍都虞候王周為河陽節度使，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: Wang Zhou, former military governor of Beizhou and chief adjutant of the northern campaign horse and foot armies, was appointed military governor of Heyang and given the additional title of honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhou, former military governor of Beizhou and northern campaign chief adjutant, became military governor of Heyang and honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以刑部侍郎竇貞固為門下侍郎，以禮部郎中邊歸讜為比部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Dou Zhengu, Vice Minister of Justice, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery; Bian Guidan, Bureau Director of the Ministry of Rites, was appointed Bureau Director of the Ministry of Revenue and given charge of drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Dou Zhengu, Vice Minister of Justice, became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Bian Guidan, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Rites, became Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue with charge of drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以河陽節度使王周為涇州節度使，以恒州節度副使王欽祚為殿中監。

translations.literal: On renwu, Wang Zhou, military governor of Heyang, was appointed military governor of Jingzhou; Wang Qinzuo, deputy military governor of Hengzhou, was appointed Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wang Zhou of Heyang became military governor of Jingzhou; Wang Qinzuo, deputy military governor of Hengzhou, became Director of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，皇妹清平公主進封衛國長公主。

translations.literal: In the second month on dinghai, the imperial younger sister, Princess Qingping, was advanced to Princess of Wei, eldest imperial sister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dinghai, the imperial younger sister Princess Qingping was advanced to Princess of Wei.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan sent envoys on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宴於武德殿，新恒州節度使杜重威已下、諸軍副兵馬使已上悉預焉，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On jichou, a banquet was held at Wude Hall; Du Chongwei, the new military governor of Hengzhou, and all deputy army commanders and above attended; gifts were bestowed in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, a banquet was held at Wude Hall for Du Chongwei, the new military governor of Hengzhou, and all deputy army commanders and above; gifts were bestowed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以曹州防禦使何建為延州留後。

translations.literal: On jihai, He Jian, defense commissioner of Caozhou, was appointed acting commissioner of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, He Jian, defense commissioner of Caozhou, was appointed acting commissioner of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 涇州奏，差押牙陳延暉賫敕書往西涼府，本府都指揮使等請以陳延暉為節度使。

translations.literal: Jingzhou reported that it had dispatched escort officer Chen Yanhui bearing an imperial edict to Xiliang Prefecture; the commanders-in-chief and others of that prefecture requested that Chen Yanhui be appointed military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou reported that escort officer Chen Yanhui had been sent with an imperial edict to Xiliang; the prefecture's commanders-in-chief asked that Chen Yanhui be made military governor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宰臣李崧丁母憂，起復舊任。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Chief Minister Li Song entered mourning for his mother and was recalled from mourning to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Chief Minister Li Song entered mourning for his mother and was recalled from mourning to resume his post.

sentences.zh: 延州蕃寇作亂，同州、鄜州各起牙兵討平之。

translations.literal: Tribal raiders rebelled at Yanzhou; Tongzhou and Binzhou each raised guard troops and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal raiders rebelled at Yanzhou; Tongzhou and Binzhou each raised guard troops and put down the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔：「鄧、唐、隨、郢諸州，多有曠土，宜令人戶取便開耕，與免五年差稅。」

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict stated: "In the prefectures of Deng, Tang, Sui, and Ying there is much idle land; households should be permitted to open and cultivate it at their convenience, and granted exemption from corvée levies for five years."
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, an edict declared: "In Deng, Tang, Sui, and Ying there is much idle land; let households cultivate it as they see fit and exempt them from corvée levies for five years."

sentences.zh: 三月己未，兵部尚書韓惲卒。

translations.literal: In the third month on jiwei, Han Yun, Minister of War, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiwei, Han Yun, Minister of War, died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣前齊州防禦使宋光鄴、翰林茶酒使張言使於契丹。

translations.literal: On gengshen, former defense commissioner of Qizhou Song Guangye and Hanlin tea and wine commissioner Zhang Yan were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Song Guangye, former defense commissioner of Qizhou, and Zhang Yan, Hanlin tea and wine commissioner, were sent as envoys to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，分命朝臣諸寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On renxu, court officials were separately ordered to pray for rain at various temples and monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, court officials were assigned separately to pray for rain at temples and monasteries.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇后為妹契丹樞密使趙延壽妻燕國長公主卒於幽州，舉哀於外次。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Empress mourned her younger sister, the Princess of Yan, wife of Khitan commissioner of military affairs Zhao Yanshou, who had died at Youzhou; lamentation was held at the outer lodge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Empress mourned her younger sister, Princess of Yan, wife of the Khitan commissioner of military affairs Zhao Yanshou, who had died at Youzhou; lamentation was held at the outer lodge.

sentences.zh: 辛未，滑州節度使、駙馬都尉史匡翰卒，輟朝，贈太保。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Shi Kuanghan, military governor of Huazhou and commander of the imperial sons-in-law, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously conferred as Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Shi Kuanghan, military governor of Huazhou and commander of the imperial sons-in-law, died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔唐州湖陽縣蓼山神祠宜賜號為「蓼山顯順之神」。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the shrine to the god of Liaoshan in Huyang County, Tangzhou, be granted the title "Manifest and Compliant God of Liaoshan."
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the shrine to the god of Liaoshan in Huyang County, Tangzhou, the title "Manifest and Compliant God of Liaoshan."

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以晉昌軍節度使安審琦為河中節度使，以前亳州防禦使王令溫為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai, An Shenqi, military governor of the Jinchang Army, was appointed military governor of Hezhong; Wang Lingwen, former defense commissioner of Bozhou, was appointed military governor of Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, An Shenqi of the Jinchang Army became military governor of Hezhong; Wang Lingwen, former defense commissioner of Bozhou, became military governor of Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜宰臣李崧白藤肩輿，以起復故也。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Chief Minister Li Song was granted a white-rattan sedan chair because he had been recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Chief Minister Li Song was granted a white-rattan sedan chair on his recall from mourning.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以晉州節度使皇甫遇為河陽節度使，以壽州節度使兼侍衛步馬軍指揮使李守貞為滑州節度使，以夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹為相州節度使，皆典軍如故。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Huangfu Yu, military governor of Jinzhou, was appointed military governor of Heyang; Li Shouzhen, military governor of Shouzhou and commander of the palace guard foot and cavalry, was appointed military governor of Huazhou; Guo Jin, military governor of Kuizhou and commander of the palace guard infantry, was appointed military governor of Xiangzhou; all continued to command the armies as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Huangfu Yu of Jinzhou became military governor of Heyang; Li Shouzhen of Shouzhou, commander of the palace foot and cavalry, became military governor of Huazhou; Guo Jin of Kuizhou, commander of the palace infantry, became military governor of Xiangzhou; all continued to command their armies as before.

sentences.zh: 宰臣於寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: The chief ministers prayed for rain at temples and monasteries.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers prayed for rain at temples and monasteries.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，以兵部郎中司徒詡為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on bingxu, Situ Xu, Bureau Director of the Ministry of War, was appointed Right Remonstrance Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on bingxu, Situ Xu, Bureau Director in the Ministry of War, became Right Remonstrance Counselor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，兗州節度使桑維翰加特進，封開國公。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Sang Weihan, military governor of Yanzhou, was given the special advancement rank and enfeoffed as Duke of the State-Founding line.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Sang Weihan, military governor of Yanzhou, received the special advancement rank and was enfeoffed as Duke of the State-Founding line.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以延州留後何建為延州節度使，以引進使兼殿中監劉政恩為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On gengyin, He Jian, acting commissioner of Yanzhou, was appointed military governor of Yanzhou; Liu Zheng'en, Introduction Bureau commissioner and Director of the Palace Domestic Service, was appointed Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, He Jian, acting commissioner of Yanzhou, became military governor of Yanzhou; Liu Zheng'en, Introduction Bureau commissioner and Director of Palace Domestic Service, became Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宋州節度使安彥威奏，修滑州黃河功畢。

translations.literal: On renchen, An Yanwei, military governor of Songzhou, reported that work on repairing the Yellow River at Huazhou was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, An Yanwei, military governor of Songzhou, reported that Yellow River repair work at Huazhou was finished.

sentences.zh: 詔於河決之地建碑立廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that a stele and shrine be erected at the site of the river breach.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a stele and shrine erected at the site of the river breach.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以鄜州節度使周密為晉州節度使，以左羽林統軍符彥卿為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhou Mi, military governor of Binzhou, was appointed military governor of Jinzhou; Fu Yanqing, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, was appointed military governor of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhou Mi of Binzhou became military governor of Jinzhou; Fu Yanqing, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, became military governor of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔百官五日一度起居，日輪定兩員，具所見以封事奏聞。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict ordered that civil and military officials attend court once every five days, with two officials fixed in rotation each day to set forth their observations in sealed memorials to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict required officials to attend court once every five days, with two on rotation each day to submit sealed memorials of their observations.

sentences.zh: 詔改鄴都宣明門為朱鳳門；

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Xuaming Gate of Yedu be renamed Zhufeng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed Yedu's Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;

sentences.zh: 武德殿為視政殿，文思殿為崇德殿，畫堂為天清殿，寢殿為乾福殿，其門悉從殿名；

translations.literal: Wude Hall was renamed Shizheng Hall, Wensi Hall was renamed Chongde Hall, the Painted Hall was renamed Tianqing Hall, and the sleeping hall was renamed Qianfu Hall, their gates all taking names from the halls;
translations.idiomatic: Wude Hall became Shizheng Hall, Wensi Hall became Chongde Hall, the Painted Hall became Tianqing Hall, and the sleeping hall became Qianfu Hall, with gates renamed to match;

sentences.zh: 皇城南門為乾明門，北門為元德門，東門為萬春門，西門為千秋門；

translations.literal: the south gate of the imperial city was Qianming Gate, the north gate Yuande Gate, the east gate Wanchun Gate, and the west gate Qianqiu Gate;
translations.idiomatic: the imperial city's south gate was Qianming, the north Yuande, the east Wanchun, and the west Qianqiu;

sentences.zh: 羅城南磚門為廣運門，觀音門為金明門，橙槽門為清景門，寇氏門為永芳門，朝臣門為景風門；

translations.literal: the south brick gate of the outer wall was Guangyun Gate, Guanyin Gate was Jinming Gate, Chengcao Gate was Qingjing Gate, Koushi Gate was Yongfang Gate, and Chaochen Gate was Jingfeng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: the outer wall's south brick gate became Guangyun, Guanyin became Jinming, Chengcao became Qingjing, Koushi became Yongfang, and Chaochen became Jingfeng;

sentences.zh: 大城南門為昭明門，觀音門為廣義門，北河門為靜安門，魏縣門為應福門，寇氏門為迎春門，朝城門為興仁門，上斗門為延清門，下斗門為通遠門。

translations.literal: the great city's south gate was Zhaoming Gate, Guanyin Gate was Guangyi Gate, Beihe Gate was Jing'an Gate, Weixian Gate was Yingfu Gate, Koushi Gate was Yingchun Gate, Chaocheng Gate was Xingren Gate, Shangdou Gate was Yanqing Gate, and Xiadou Gate was Tongyuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: the great city's south gate became Zhaoming, Guanyin became Guangyi, Beihe became Jing'an, Weixian became Yingfu, Koushi became Yingchun, Chaocheng became Xingren, Shangdou became Yanqing, and Xiadou became Tongyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宋州節度使安彥威封邠國公，賞修河之勞也。

translations.literal: On wushen, An Yanwei, military governor of Songzhou, was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin, in reward for his labor on the river works.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, An Yanwei, military governor of Songzhou, was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin in reward for his river repair work.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，涇州節度使王周奏，前節度使張彥澤在任日不法事二十六條，已改正停廢。

translations.literal: On guichou, Wang Zhou, military governor of Jingzhou, reported that twenty-six illegal acts committed by former military governor Zhang Yanzhe during his tenure had been corrected and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Wang Zhou of Jingzhou reported that twenty-six illegal practices from former military governor Zhang Yanzhe's tenure had been corrected and abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔褒之。

translations.literal: An edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 是春，鄴都、鳳翔、兗、陜、汝、恒、陳等州旱，鄆、曹、澶、博、相、洺諸州蝗。

translations.literal: That spring, Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, Chen, and other prefectures suffered drought; Yan, Cao, Chan, Bo, Xiang, Ming, and other prefectures suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, Chen, and other prefectures suffered drought; Yan, Cao, Chan, Bo, Xiang, Ming, and other prefectures suffered locust plagues.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅朔，避正殿不視朝，日蝕故也。

translations.literal: On the first day of the month (jiayin) in the fourth month of summer, the Emperor avoided the main hall and did not hold court, because of a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon (jiayin) of the fourth summer month, the Emperor avoided the main hall and declined court because of a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是日，太陽不虧，百官上表稱賀。

translations.literal: That day the sun was not eclipsed; the civil and military officials submitted memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: That day the sun was not eclipsed; the officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 詔沿河藩郡節度使、刺史並兼管內河堤使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that military governors and prefects of feudatory prefectures along the river all concurrently serve as commissioners of river dikes within their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required military governors and prefects along the river to serve concurrently as river-dike commissioners within their jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 己未，右諫議大夫鄭受益兩疏論張彥澤在涇州之日，違法虐民，支解掌書記張式、部曲楊洪等，請下所司，明申其罪。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Zheng Shouyi, Right Remonstrance Counselor, submitted two memorials stating that during Zhang Yanzhe's days at Jingzhou he had violated the law and abused the people, dismembered chief secretary Zhang Shi, his retainer Yang Hong, and others, and requesting that the responsible offices be ordered to state his crimes clearly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zheng Shouyi, Right Remonstrance Counselor, submitted two memorials charging that Zhang Yanzhe at Jingzhou had violated the law, abused the people, and dismembered chief secretary Zhang Shi, retainer Yang Hong, and others, and asking that the responsible offices clearly establish his crimes.

sentences.zh: 皆留中不出。

translations.literal: All were retained at court and not issued.
translations.idiomatic: All were retained at court and not acted upon.

sentences.zh: 庚申，刑部郎中李濤、張麟，員外郎麻麟、王禧，同詣閣門上疏，論張彥澤罪犯，詞甚懇切。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Li Tao and Zhang Lin, Bureau Directors of the Ministry of Justice, and Ma Lin and Wang Xi, Assistant Bureau Directors, together went to the Gate of the Imperial Secretariat and submitted a memorial discussing Zhang Yanzhe's crimes in very earnest language.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Li Tao and Zhang Lin of the Ministry of Justice and Ma Lin and Wang Xi, assistant bureau directors, together submitted a memorial at the Gate of the Imperial Secretariat charging Zhang Yanzhe in very earnest terms.

translations.literal: [Editorial note:
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·李濤傳》：涇帥張彥澤殺記室張式，奪其妻，式家人詣闕上訴，晉祖以彥澤有軍功，釋其罪。

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Li Tao: The Jingzhou military governor Zhang Yanzhe killed secretary Zhang Shi and seized his wife; Shi's family went to the capital to appeal; the Jin founder, because Yanzhe had military merit, released him from guilt.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Li Tao in the Song History: Zhang Yanzhe, military governor of Jingzhou, killed secretary Zhang Shi and seized his wife; Shi's family appealed at court; the Jin founder, citing Yanzhe's military merit, pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 濤伏閣抗疏，請置於法。

translations.literal: Tao lay prostrate at the gate and submitted a defiant memorial, requesting that the law be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Tao lay prostrate at the gate and submitted a defiant memorial demanding legal punishment.

sentences.zh: 晉祖召見諭之，濤植笏叩階，聲色俱厲，晉祖怒叱之，濤執笏如初。

translations.literal: The Jin founder summoned him and admonished him; Tao planted his tablet and struck the steps; his voice and expression were both fierce; the Jin founder angrily rebuked him, but Tao held his tablet as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin founder summoned and admonished him; Tao struck the steps with his tablet, voice and expression fierce; the founder rebuked him angrily, but Tao held his tablet unchanged.

sentences.zh: 晉祖曰：「吾與彥澤有誓約，恕其死。

translations.literal: The Jin founder said: "I have a sworn agreement with Yanzhe and pardon his death.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin founder said: "I have a sworn pact with Yanzhe and spare his life.

sentences.zh: 」濤厲聲曰：「彥澤私誓，陛下不忍食其言；

translations.literal: " Tao said in a harsh voice: "Yanzhe's private oath—Your Majesty cannot bear to break your word;
translations.idiomatic: " Tao said harshly: "Yanzhe's private oath—Your Majesty cannot bear to break your word;

sentences.zh: 範延光嘗賜鐵券，今復安在？

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang was once granted an iron certificate—where is it now?"
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang was once granted an iron certificate—where is it now?"

sentences.zh: 」晉祖不能答，即拂衣起。）〉

translations.literal: " The Jin founder could not answer and immediately rose and brushed off his robes.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " The Jin founder had no reply and rose at once.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「張彥澤刳剔賓從，誅剝生聚，冤聲穢跡，流聞四方，章表繼來，指陳甚切。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict stated: "Zhang Yanzhe has flayed and dismembered guests and followers, executed and stripped the living populace; cries of injustice and foul traces have spread to the four quarters; memorials have come in succession, pointing out the matter with great urgency.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict declared: "Zhang Yanzhe has flayed guests and followers, executed and stripped the living; cries of injustice have spread everywhere; memorials have poured in with urgent charges.

sentences.zh: 尚以曾施微功，特示寬恩。

translations.literal: Yet because he once rendered slight merit, special leniency is shown.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because he once rendered slight service, special leniency is shown.

sentences.zh: 深懷曲法之慚，貴徇議勞之典。

translations.literal: We deeply feel shame at bending the law and value the precedent of honoring those who labor in counsel.
translations.idiomatic: We deeply regret bending the law yet value honoring those who labor in counsel.

sentences.zh: 其張彥澤宜削一階，仍降爵一紀。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanzhe should be reduced one rank and his noble title lowered one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanzhe shall be reduced one rank and his noble title lowered one grade.

sentences.zh: 其張式宜贈官，張式父鐸、弟守貞、男希範並與除官。

translations.literal: Zhang Shi should receive posthumous office; Zhang Shi's father Duo, younger brother Shouzhen, and son Xifan shall all be granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi shall receive posthumous office; his father Duo, younger brother Shouzhen, and son Xifan shall all be granted office.

sentences.zh: 仍於涇州賜錢十萬，差人津置張式靈柩並骨肉歸鄉，所有先收納卻張式家財物畜，並令卻還。

translations.literal: Moreover, one hundred thousand in cash shall be granted at Jingzhou, and men dispatched to provide transport for Zhang Shi's coffin and his kin to return home; all household goods, property, and livestock previously seized from Zhang Shi's family shall be ordered returned.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, one hundred thousand cash shall be granted at Jingzhou, with escorts to convey Zhang Shi's coffin and family home; all goods and livestock seized from his family shall be returned.

sentences.zh: 其涇州新歸業戶，量與蠲減稅賦。

translations.literal: For newly returned households at Jingzhou, taxes shall be remitted in appropriate measure.
translations.idiomatic: For newly returned households at Jingzhou, taxes shall be remitted as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」翌日，以前涇州節度使張彥澤為左龍武大將軍。

translations.literal: " The next day, Zhang Yanzhe, former military governor of Jingzhou, was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: " The next day, Zhang Yanzhe, former military governor of Jingzhou, was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Dragon Martial Army.

translations.literal: [Editorial note:
translations.idiomatic: [Editorial note:

sentences.zh: （《宋史·楊昭儉傳》：昭儉與李濤論張彥澤不報，會有詔命朝臣轉對，或有封事，亦許以不時條奏。

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Yang Zhaojian: Zhaojian and Li Tao discussed Zhang Yanzhe without response; there came an edict ordering court officials to present rotating remonstrances, and sealed memorials were also permitted to be submitted at irregular times.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Yang Zhaojian in the Song History: Zhaojian and Li Tao had raised Zhang Yanzhe without response; an edict then ordered rotating remonstrances from court officials, and sealed memorials could be submitted at irregular times.

sentences.zh: 昭儉復上疏曰：「天子君臨四海，日有萬幾，懋建諍臣，彌縫其闕。

translations.literal: Zhaojian again submitted a memorial stating: "The Son of Heaven rules the four seas and has ten thousand affairs daily; remonstrating officials are earnestly established to mend his shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaojian submitted another memorial: "The Son of Heaven rules the four seas with ten thousand daily affairs; remonstrating officials exist to mend his shortcomings.

sentences.zh: 今則諫臣雖設，言路不通。

translations.literal: Now remonstrating officials exist in name, but the path of speech is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Now remonstrating officials exist in name, but the path of remonstrance is blocked.

sentences.zh: 藥石之論，不達於聖聰，而邪佞之徒，取容於左右。

translations.literal: Remedies like medicine and stone do not reach the sage's hearing, while flatterers and the wicked win favor at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Honest counsel does not reach the sage's ear, while flatterers and the wicked win favor at his side.

sentences.zh: 御史臺紀綱之府，彈糾之司。

translations.literal: The Censorate is the office of discipline and the agency of impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate is the office of discipline and the agency of impeachment.

sentences.zh: 銜冤者固當昭雪，為蠹者難免放流。

translations.literal: Those bearing grievances should naturally be cleared; those who are pests should hardly escape banishment.
translations.idiomatic: Those bearing grievances should be cleared; pests should hardly escape banishment.

sentences.zh: 陛下臨御以來，寬仁太甚，徒置兩司，殆如虛器。

translations.literal: Since Your Majesty began to rule, leniency has been excessive; these two offices stand idle, nearly like empty vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty began to rule, leniency has been excessive; these two offices stand nearly idle, like empty vessels.

sentences.zh: 遂令節使慢侮朝章，屠害幕吏。

translations.literal: Thus military governors have come to despise court regulations and slaughter staff officers.
translations.idiomatic: Thus military governors despise court regulations and slaughter staff officers.

sentences.zh: 始訴冤於丹闕，反執送於本藩，茍安跋扈之心，莫恤冤抑之苦。

translations.literal: They first appeal grievances at the crimson gate, yet are sent back under escort to their own circuits, securing arrogant hearts and showing no concern for the pain of suppressed injustice.
translations.idiomatic: They appeal at the crimson gate yet are sent back to their circuits, securing arrogant hearts with no concern for suppressed injustice.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "The season is oppressively hot; court business should be simplified.

sentences.zh: 應五日百官起居，望令押班宰臣一員押百官班，其轉對官兩員封付閣門使引進，本官隨百僚退，不用別出謝恩。

translations.literal: For the five-day court attendance of officials, we hope one chief minister on duty may lead the officials' formation; the two rotating remonstrance officials shall seal their memorials and hand them to the Gate commissioners for introduction, and the officials themselves shall withdraw with the hundred officials without separately coming forth to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 其文武內外官僚乞假、寧覲、搬家、婚葬、病損並門見門辭。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside requesting leave, visiting parents, moving house, weddings and funerals, or illness shall all take leave and bid farewell at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials requesting leave, visiting parents, moving house, weddings, funerals, or illness shall take leave and bid farewell at the gate.

sentences.zh: 諸道進奉物等，不用殿前排列，引進使引至殿前奏云『某等進奉』，奏訖，令進奉使便出。

translations.idiomatic: Circuit tribute need not be arrayed before the hall; Introduction commissioners shall lead envoys forward to report tribute, then let them withdraw at once.

sentences.zh: 其進奉專使朝見日，班首一人致詞，都附起居。

translations.literal: On the day tribute envoys attend court, one leader of the formation shall deliver the address, all included in the regular attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day tribute envoys attend court, one formation leader shall speak, all included in regular attendance.

sentences.zh: 刺史並行軍副使、諸道馬步軍都指揮使已下，差人到闕，並門見門辭。

translations.literal: Prefects, deputy campaign commanders, and commanders-in-chief of horse and foot armies in the circuits and below who dispatch men to the capital shall all take leave and bid farewell at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects, deputy campaign commanders, and circuit army commanders-in-chief and below who send men to the capital shall take leave and bid farewell at the gate.

sentences.zh: 州縣官謝恩日，甲頭一人都致詞，不用逐人告官。

translations.literal: On the day of thanksgiving audiences for prefectural and county officials, one formation leader shall deliver the address for all; individual officials need not report one by one.
translations.idiomatic: On thanksgiving audiences for prefectural and county officials, one formation leader shall speak for all; individual reports are not required.

sentences.zh: 其供奉官、殿直等，如是當直及合於殿前排立者，即入起居；

translations.literal: For tribute commissioners, palace attendants, and the like, if they are on duty and should stand in formation before the hall, they shall enter for attendance;
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendants and commissioners on duty who should stand before the hall shall enter for attendance;

translations.idiomatic: those not on duty for formation need not attend daily.

sentences.zh: 委宣徽使點檢，常須整齊。

translations.idiomatic: Palace Secretariat commissioners shall inspect and maintain order at all times.

translations.idiomatic: That month, five prefectures reported great floods and eighteen reported drought and locusts.

translations.idiomatic: Gao Xingzhou, overall commander at Xiangzhou, reported that Li Guangtu, observation commissioner under An Congjin, had left the city to request aid and was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，帝崩於保昌殿，壽五十一。

translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Emperor died at Baochang Hall at the age of fifty-one.

translations.idiomatic: For the rhyme of "shoot" is close to "stone."

translations.literal: Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties: At the beginning of Kaiping of Liang, Li Si'an, field commissioner at Luzhou, reported that at Rang Township, Hanguan County, when the people felled a tree, it fell and split in two of itself; within were six characters written like those at left, reading "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances"; the Liang Emperor stored it in the armory, and at the time none understood its meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties: early in Liang Kaiping, Li Si'an, field commissioner at Luzhou, reported that at Rang Township, Hanguan County, a felled tree split in two of itself, revealing six characters reading "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances"; the Liang Emperor stored it in the armory, and none then understood its meaning.

sentences.zh: 至帝即位，識者曰：「天」字取「四」字兩畫加之於傍，即「丙」字也；

translations.literal: When the Emperor took the throne, those who understood said: "The character 'Heaven'—take the two strokes of the character 'four' and add them at the side, and it becomes the character 'bing';"
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor took the throne, interpreters said: "From 'Heaven,' take the two strokes of 'four' and add them at the side to make 'bing';"

sentences.zh: 「四」字去中之兩畫加「十」字，即「申」字也。

translations.literal: "the character 'four'—remove the two strokes in the middle and add the character 'ten,' and it becomes the character 'shen.'"
translations.idiomatic: "from 'four,' remove the middle two strokes and add 'ten' to make 'shen.'"

sentences.zh: 帝即位之年，乃「丙申」也。

translations.literal: The year the Emperor took the throne was indeed bingshen.
translations.idiomatic: The year the Emperor took the throne was indeed bingshen.

translations.idiomatic: "Advances" means Jin; "Stone" is the surname.

translations.literal: Your servant respectfully notes: in the twentieth year of Tianyou, the year was guiwei; that year Zhuangzong established his reign title and changed the era to Tongguang 1; down to the third year of Qingtai, the year bingshen, when the Jin founder took the throne and changed the era to Tianfu 1—from wei to shen was fourteen years in all; thus the prophecy reading "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances" means that fourteen years after the fall of Tianyou the Shi clan rose in Jin—is this not clear!

translations.literal: The historian says: Before the Jin founder's hidden rise, he was merely deep and resolute.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Before the Jin founder's hidden rise, he was merely deep and resolute.

sentences.zh: 及其為君也，旰食宵衣，禮賢從諫，慕黃、老之教，樂清凈之風，以絁為衣，以麻為履，故能保其社稷，高朗令終。

translations.literal: When he became ruler, he ate late and rose early, honored the worthy and accepted remonstrance, admired the teachings of Huang-Lao, delighted in the style of purity and stillness, wore coarse silk for garments and hemp for shoes, and thus was able to preserve his state and altar, ending his life in lofty clarity.
translations.idiomatic: As ruler he ate late and rose early, honored the worthy and accepted remonstrance, admired Huang-Lao teachings, delighted in purity and stillness, wore coarse silk and hemp shoes, and thus preserved his state and ended his life in lofty clarity.

sentences.zh: 然而圖事之初，召戎來援，獫狁自茲而孔熾，黔黎由是以罹殃。

translations.literal: Yet at the beginning of his plotting he summoned barbarians for aid; from then on the Xianyun grew greatly fierce, and the black-haired people thereby suffered calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at the start of his plotting he summoned barbarians for aid; from then the northern tribes grew greatly fierce, and the common people suffered calamity.

sentences.zh: 迨至嗣君，兵連禍結，卒使都城失守，舉族為俘。

translations.literal: By the time of the succeeding ruler, war linked with disaster, until at last the capital was lost and the whole clan taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: By the succeeding ruler's reign, war and disaster compounded until the capital fell and the whole clan was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 亦猶決鯨海以救焚，何逃沒溺；

translations.literal: It was like breaching the whale-sea to save a fire—how could drowning be escaped;
translations.idiomatic: It was like breaching the ocean to fight a fire—how could drowning be escaped;

sentences.zh: 飲鴆漿而止渴，終取喪亡。

translations.literal: drinking poison to quench thirst, and in the end bringing ruin and loss.
translations.idiomatic: drinking poison to quench thirst, and in the end bringing ruin.

sentences.zh: 謀之不臧，何至於是！

translations.literal: Had the planning not been ill-considered, how could it have come to this!
translations.idiomatic: Had the planning been sound, how could it have come to this!

sentences.zh: 倘使非由外援之力，自副皇天之命，以茲睿德，惠彼蒸民，雖未足以方駕前王，亦可謂仁慈恭儉之主也。

translations.literal: If he had not relied on foreign aid but had matched Heaven's mandate by himself, with this sagely virtue benefiting the common people, though he might not have equaled the former kings, he could still have been called a ruler of benevolence, respect, and frugality.
translations.idiomatic: Had he not relied on foreign aid but matched Heaven's mandate himself, with this sagely virtue benefiting the people, though he might not have equaled the former kings, he could still have been called a benevolent, respectful, and frugal ruler.
